labs.flag_hint: /debug/tmp shows /tmp files; find 'who' and correlate with the flag stored beside it.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2023-40044 — Progress WS_FTP Server

labs.title: Hop-by-Hop Auth Header Strip
labs.description: A management console requires Authorization on all /mgmt/* routes. A misconfigured server treats an attacker-supplied 'Connection: X-F5-Auth-Token, Authorization' as declaring those headers hop-by-hop, so an internal proxy trusts the pre-declared identity of 'admin'.
labs.objective: Send a request that strips Authorization and injects a trusted internal identity header, hit /mgmt/tm/util/bash, and dump the flag.
labs.flag_hint: Bash utility runs commands; run 'cat /var/flag'.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2022-1388 — F5 BIG-IP iControl REST auth bypass

labs.title: Console Encoded Traversal
labs.description: An XMPP-style admin console rejects unauthenticated /admin URLs, but the servlet router double-decodes %252E%252E, letting /setup/setup-s/%252e%252e/admin/user-summary.jsp reach the admin JSP without a session.
labs.objective: Reach user-summary.jsp via the double-encoded traversal, extract the operator's password hash, crack the seeded weak hash, log in, and read the flag from the dashboard.
labs.flag_hint: Hash is CRC-based; a small wordlist is bundled at /opt/wordlist.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2023-32315 — Openfire admin console path traversal

labs.title: phpinfo Environment Leak
labs.description: A cloud storage app ships a diagnostic subpath that includes phpinfo() output. Because environment variables surface in phpinfo, and the container was launched with S3-like credentials in env, an unauthenticated visitor can harvest them.
labs.objective: Fetch the diagnostic page, extract the S3_SECRET env var, then use it to sign a request to the app's internal object-storage endpoint that returns the flag object.
labs.flag_hint: Object key is 'flag/2026/flag.txt' in the local MinIO bucket.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2023-49103 — ownCloud phpinfo credential leak

labs.title: Interpolator Prefix Injection
labs.description: A Java 'greeting card' web app passes user-supplied names through an interpolation library configured with defaults including script:, dns:, and url:. Any input like ${script:javascript:...} runs in a JS engine on the server.
labs.objective: POST a name that runs a JS one-liner using java.lang.Runtime to write the flag into /srv/greetings/<uuid>.txt, then GET it back.
labs.flag_hint: Greeting page renders the file at /greetings/<uuid>; you set the uuid.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2022-42889 — Apache Commons Text (Text4Shell)

labs.title: Trusted-Source Header Bypass
labs.description: A firewall-style admin API skips authentication when Forwarded: for=127.0.0.1 is present, because the internal proxy tags that as a loopback client. The public listener does not strip inbound Forwarded headers.
labs.objective: Set Forwarded to the trusted magic value, call the admin-users API to create a new admin, log in, and read the flag from /api/v2/monitor/system/status.
labs.flag_hint: Status API 'motd' field contains the flag once you are admin.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2022-40684 — Fortinet FortiOS auth bypass

labs.title: SAML XML Signature Wrap
labs.description: An enterprise-style login accepts SAML assertions signed with a bundled test IdP key. The signature verifier scopes its check to //ds:Signature/../Assertion, but the assertion consumer reads /Response/Assertion — an attacker wraps an unsigned malicious assertion in the response while the signed one hides in an extension.
labs.objective: Craft an XMLDSig-wrapped Response that authenticates as admin@corp.local, complete the SAML login, then read the flag from the profile page.
labs.flag_hint: Admin profile page 'bio' field carries the flag.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2024-6800 — GitHub Enterprise SAML signature bypass

labs.title: WP-Like Plugin eval() REST Endpoint
labs.description: A WordPress-style plugin registers a REST route /wp-json/example/v1/render that eval()s PHP for logged-in users whose role includes 'contributor'. The role-check middleware trusts a client-supplied X-User-Role header for the JSON API.
labs.objective: Set X-User-Role to contributor, POST arbitrary PHP to the render endpoint, and print the flag stored as a wp_option.
labs.flag_hint: get_option('lab_flag') returns the flag; echo it.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2024-25600 — Bricks Builder unauth RCE

labs.title: Weak Nonce Role Uplift
labs.description: A caching plugin issues admin action nonces using rand() seeded per-request against the current second. An attacker can predict nonce candidates for a nearby second and submit an update_user_meta call that promotes their subscriber to administrator.
labs.objective: Predict the nonce for /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?action=lscwp_role_sim, promote your own user, then log in as admin and read the flag from Site Settings.
labs.flag_hint: Site Settings > 'welcome text' contains the flag.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2024-28000 — LiteSpeed Cache privilege escalation

labs.title: Log Viewer Path Traversal
labs.description: A data-analytics web console serves static assets from /en-US/static/app/<name>. Because the app name is normalized once but reflected twice, /en-US/static/app/search/%252E%252E/…/passwd escapes into the appliance filesystem.
labs.objective: Read /etc/appliance/secret.conf via the traversal, extract the seeded API token, and call the /services/pull-flag REST endpoint.
labs.flag_hint: The token is in the [auth] section; API returns the flag in JSON.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2024-36991 — Splunk arbitrary file read

labs.title: Admin UI Static Bypass
labs.description: A network-management console gates /admin behind SSO, but a misordered CDN rule serves /help/../admin/index.html through the unauthenticated static handler, exposing an admin bootstrap that mints a session in localStorage.
labs.objective: Reach the leaked bootstrap, replay it to /api/session/bootstrap, use the resulting session to enumerate devices, and read the flag from device 'core-01' banner.
labs.flag_hint: Banner is returned by /api/devices/core-01.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2024-8963 — Ivanti CSA path traversal

labs.title: Migration Tool Admin Reset
labs.description: A migration tool ships with a factory-reset endpoint intended only for first-boot. The check is 'has any admin logged in in the last 24h?' — trivially false on a freshly deployed lab, so anyone can reset the admin password.
labs.objective: Call /api/reset-admin?token=default, log in as admin/admin, then read the flag from the migration report page.
labs.flag_hint: Latest report's 'summary' includes the flag.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2024-5910 — Palo Alto Expedition admin reset

labs.title: SQLi to Plugin Drop
labs.description: A backup-manager WordPress-style plugin exposes a POST endpoint with a UNION-injectable path parameter. The DB user has FILE privilege, so SELECT ... INTO OUTFILE lets an attacker drop a PHP file into wp-content/plugins.
labs.objective: Chain SQLi → INTO OUTFILE to drop a small PHP page inside the plugins directory, request it, and print the flag from wp_options.
labs.flag_hint: 'lab_flag' key in wp_options.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2023-6553 — Backup Migration WP plugin

labs.title: Graph Query Sandbox Escape
labs.description: A graph-database front-end accepts Gremlin queries. Its SecurityManager blocks java.lang.Runtime but not java.lang.Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader(), which lets attackers reach an unlisted class that shell-executes.
labs.objective: Submit a Gremlin query that walks the classloader chain to hit an executor and read the flag under /data/graph/flag.gz.
labs.flag_hint: gunzip the file inside the query and return the contents via query result.
labs.inspired_by: CVE-2024-27348 — Apache HugeGraph RCE
